document_plan_subtitle: Obtain prerequisite core documents first to unlock the most schemes in fewer visits to offices.

pre_trip_prep_desc: Carry these essential items to prevent multiple trips to the Tahsildar / Setu Kendra:
prep_tip_1: Keep 4 recent passport-size photos with blue/white background.
prep_tip_2: Carry original Aadhaar Card and at least 3 self-attested photocopies.
prep_tip_3: Active mobile phone linked to your Aadhaar for receiving OTP verifications.
prep_tip_4: Bank Passbook showing active Account Number and IFSC (Aadhaar NPCI mapped).
